title: RPI management helper ALERT text becomes printf format
summary: execute_command supplies helper ALERT text as indigo_update_property format without arguments. Maintained rpi_ctrl.sh:574-578 and rpi_ctrl_v2.sh:565-569 echo failed date input from HOST_TIME, preserving percent directives despite shell quoting. Deployed s_rpi_ctrl.sh wrapper contract required; actual packaging untested. Undefined variadic reads can crash/disclose data; write directives can corrupt memory. Source-only confirmation, no exploitation run. Next: Use literal %s or raw-update API for helper output; handle absent message explicitly; test percent-containing diagnostics with stub helper.
